vision: A dependable todo list that a small team can start using tomorrow.

objectives.text: Let a team member capture a task the moment it occurs, and later correct its wording or remove it, without re-entering anything.
Let a team member record and reverse completion for one task or for the whole list in a single action.
Keep each list free of clutter by letting a team member sweep away all finished tasks in one action.
Let a team member review their list as everything, only what remains, or only what is done, and always see at a glance exactly how many tasks remain.
Ensure no team member ever loses a task because they closed the app, restarted their device, or the app was restarted.
Let both people and the team's existing automated assistants work the same todo list, so the list fits the way the team already works.
Let a small team adopt the app for daily use on the day it ships, with no training, because it behaves exactly as people expect a todo list to behave.

mission: Keep every team member's todos in one dependable, team-owned record that outlives any session, and let people and the team's assistants work that same record through whichever channel they already use. Hold the experience to the familiar, well-known todo-list behavior so it needs no learning and every action takes a single step.
